performance.scope: Unmodified production assets. Test-only public Canvas/rAF/PerformanceObserver wrappers; no application instance reference, source transformation, or product hooks. Cold means first render after camera invalidation at the first public zoom step>=100%(actual zoom/matrix recorded), not document decode/startup. Main callback CPU time, request-to-callback queue delay, LongTasks, rAF gaps and logical Canvas API work are separate. No forcedGC; browserGC may contribute. coldApiDiagnostics.scope: Separate one-plus-one fresh profiledDPR2 cold frame; unmodified production, public Canvas/rAF wrappers only. Not pooled with12 unprofiled repeats or original observations. Callback/native durations are elapsed wall time, not CPU cycles. Native API timings show synchronous call locations, not origin of deferred work, GPU completion or GC attribution.
limits: Additional per-call timestamps, closures, stack/category/call records and proxy dispatch add overhead; no subtraction/calibration, so these absolute durations cannot replace unprofiled results.
Inclusive API category sums and top-level nonoverlapping totals are kept separately; remaining=callback minus nonoverlapping native intervals. Native methods may expose earlier queued work.
Timer precision quantizes shortcalls;0ms does not imply no work.

Large uninstrumented gaps may include JavaScript, other native properties/methods, callback/layout/runtime work. They are not identified as GC, source loops, capture cost, or grid cause without further evidence.
